expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第4–6天运行未登记配方 R-X（更高速度和负载）。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 4–6: unregistered recipe R-X runs (higher speed and load).

ground_truth.zh: 工况超出已知集合；设备健康。
ground_truth.en: Regime outside the known set; equipment healthy.

expected_health_response.zh: R-X 期间返回不支持预测（UNSUPPORTED_REGIME）→ UNKNOWN；其余时间 NORMAL。
expected_health_response.en: During R-X return unsupported prediction (UNSUPPORTED_REGIME) → UNKNOWN; NORMAL otherwise.

abstention_cases.zh: 未知工况必须弃权（UNSUPPORTED_REGIME），不得用已知工况基线判定。
abstention_cases.en: Unknown regimes must abstain (UNSUPPORTED_REGIME), never judged against known-regime baselines.
